 Confirmed Celtic line-up and team news for Celta Vigo Europa League clash
 Ellis Statham
 Updated: 44 minutes ago
 Celtic will be looking to earn their first victory of the 2026/27 Europa League campaign when welcoming Celta Vigo to Glasgow on Thursday night. 
 The Hoops have enjoyed a productive start to the Scottish Premiership season -- winning eight of their nine top-flight contests -- but they're yet to experience the same success in the Europa League .
 They commenced their European journey with a 3-1 home defeat against Hungarian outfit Ferencvarosi, before losing 4-1 to joint-favourites Benfica last week.
 Off the back of an emphatic 7-1 win against Hearts at the weekend, Martin O'Neill's Celtic will be searching for their first points of the tournament against a Celta Vigo side who are also winless in the competition thus far.
 Celtic v Celta Vigo 
 View Latest Odds 
 O'Neill has made one change to the Celtic side that cruised to victory against Hearts on Sunday.
 Sam Johnstone replaces Viljami Sinisalo in between the sticks.
 Alistair Johnston, Cameron Carter-Vickers and Yang Hyun-jun are sidelined through injury, while Auston Trusty misses out due to a private matter.
 Celtic team to play Celta Vigo
 Sam Johnstone, Colby Donovan, Dane Murray, Liam Scales, Kieran Tierney, Callum McGregor, Mika Baur, Benjamin Nygren, Haissem Hassan, Callum Osmand, Camilo Durán.
